summary: Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio's squad-based science-fiction shooter set in future Tokyo.

entries.title: Binary Domain

primary.why: Binary Domain released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in February 2012 and Windows in April 2012. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively; use console versions only for original-hardware comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No later remaster is documented in the cited public source.
